grupo-entrar.prompt: Short friendly UI pop, soft bubbly click confirming you joined a game, clean, no music

grupo-tique.prompt: Single crisp clock tick for a game show countdown, dry wooden click, very short

grupo-inicio.prompt: Bright short game show start sting, rising synth arpeggio with a soft whoosh, modern and upbeat, 2 seconds

grupo-acerto.prompt: Positive correct answer chime, two bright bell notes going up, game show style, clean

grupo-erro.prompt: Gentle wrong answer sound, soft low descending two-note synth buzz, not harsh, game show style

grupo-revelar.prompt: Quick game show reveal hit, short snare drum roll ending in a punchy cymbal accent

grupo-fanfarra.prompt: Celebratory victory fanfare for the end of a game show, short brass and synth flourish with applause tail

desenho-acerto.prompt: Cheerful sparkle pling when a player guesses the word in a drawing game, light and quick

desenho-vez.prompt: Soft attention chime meaning it is your turn to draw, warm marimba two notes

desenho-quase.prompt: Tiny playful hmm-like blip meaning almost right, short soft synth wobble

stop-roleta.prompt: Wheel of letters spinning and slowing down, fast ticking clicks that decelerate and stop with a soft ding

stop-grito.prompt: Loud fun game buzzer for shouting STOP in a word game, short and punchy, playful

stop-largada.prompt: Short referee whistle blow to start a round, bright and quick
